description: Takes an offering off everywhere it shows: Brand's What you offer, Sell's ways in, the plans and pages Marsell makes, and the facts it writes from (an owner rule keeps it out of every post and page). Use it when the owner says to remove something from what they offer, or that something listed is not theirs. Read offerings_read first and pass every name it goes by; a name written nowhere is refused. Sell's list is then read again in the background, at what that read costs. Returns the names taken off and the rule written; offering_restore puts it back. It needs an act key.

names.description: every name the offering goes by: as What you offer shows it, as Sell lists it, and as the facts write it (offerings_read shows them); one offering, or several the owner named

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

why.description: not_ours: the owner says it is not theirs (another company's, a client's, a mistake); not_offered: it is theirs but no longer sold

name: offering_remove
title: Offering remove
